'''Yannick Lapointe profit beatdown''' is the [[Light]] constructed list [[Yannick Lapointe]] posted on DeckTech.<ref name="dt-5961">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/5961 profit beatdown], DeckTech (Yannick "Crusher" Lapointe, 25 April 2000). == Original post ==

'''profit beatdown'''
* '''Author:''' Yannick "Crusher" Lapointe
* '''Published:''' April 25, 2000
* '''Rating:''' 4.5
* '''Description:''' this is a profit beatdown

=== Strategy ===

start with han solo frozen and goo nee tay if he deploy character beatdown as fast as you can and if he dont choke him and rescue han pretty easy deck to play
